create.name: Michelle Robertson
create.bio:
Michelle Robertson, known to her students as Shell, teaches yoga and meditation in the Sutherland Shire in southern Sydney under the name The YinSide. She trained at HYA Yoga Studio and Academy in Miranda, with Sarah Owen Yoga and Mindfulness and at The Practice in Bali, and is registered with Yoga Alliance, with qualifications in Hatha, Vinyasa, Yin and chair yoga, meditation teaching and holistic human development. She is also a Reiki practitioner and a certified Roll Model Method practitioner, and has been teaching for more than ten years.

Her classes are calm and unhurried, with close attention to alignment and long, supported Yin holds paired with breath awareness and mindfulness, and she draws on the meridian ideas of Traditional Chinese Medicine to shape seasonal sessions. Each week she teaches women-only flow and Yin classes in a home studio in Caringbah as well as evening classes at a local wellness studio, and she offers private lessons and sessions for workplaces and community groups. Several times a year she co-leads women's weekend retreats in the New South Wales countryside and afternoon Yin and sound workshops with local sound practitioners. On Insight Timer she shares gentle morning and evening practices, chakra meditations and short Yin sequences.

courses.title: Women's Yin & Mindfulness @ The YinSide
courses.description: A weekly women-only Yin class on Tuesday and Thursday mornings at her home studio in Caringbah. Floor-based poses are held for several minutes with bolsters and props, alongside breathing practices and a long settle into meditation; open to all levels.

courses.title: Women's Flow Yoga @ The YinSide Home
courses.description: A gentle morning flow class for women on Tuesdays and Thursdays in Caringbah, covering the basics of breath-linked movement and alignment at an easy pace. Beginners are welcome.

courses.title: The YinSide Class Packs
courses.description: Five- or ten-class passes for her classes at The YinSide home studio, each valid for twelve months. The ten-class pass is $200 AUD.

courses.title: Yin & Mindfulness @ In Balance
courses.description: Her Tuesday evening Yin and mindfulness class at In Balance Wellness Studio in Caringbah, open to drop-ins and booked directly with the studio.

courses.title: Private Classes and Group Sessions
courses.description: Private yoga lessons tailored to one person, and sessions at your venue for workplaces, schools, sports teams and women's or community groups, including a breath, relaxation and meditation workshop for teams.

free_resources.title: Michelle Robertson on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Her short guided meditations for starting and ending the day, gratitude practices, chakra meditations and Yin yoga with mindfulness, free to play in the app or on the web.
